name: dooh-ooh-advertising-research
title: DOOH & OOH Advertising Research Dataset
description: 144 peer-reviewed claims documenting evidence-based risks of Out-of-Home and Digital Out-of-Home advertising infrastructure. Covers regulatory bans, public health harm, environmental impact, privacy law (EU AI Act, GDPR), traffic safety, and market concentration. Bilingual DE/EN. All sources independent.
